title: Causal Inference Under Unmeasured Confounding With Negative Controls: A Minimax Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2103.14029v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the estimation of causal parameters when not all confounders are observed and instead negative controls are available. Recent work has shown how these can enable identification and efficient estimation via two so-called bridge functions. In this paper, we tackle the primary challenges in causal inference with negative controls: identifying and estimating these bridge functions. Previous work has typically relied on completeness conditions for identification, imposed uniqueness assumptions for estimation, and focused on parametric models for the bridge functions. Instead, we provide an alternative identification strategy that assumes the existence of two bridge functions rather than completeness conditions. We also provide new estimators for these functions based on minimax learning formulations. translated_title: 未测量混杂因素下基于负控制变量的因果推断：一种极小极大学习方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当并非所有混杂因素都被观测到、而负控制变量可用时因果参数的估计问题。最近的研究表明，通过两个所谓的桥函数可以实现因果效应的识别和有效估计。在本文中，我们解决了基于负控制变量进行因果推断的核心挑战：识别和估计这些桥函数。以往的工作通常依赖于完备性条件进行识别，施加唯一性假设进行估计，并专注于桥函数的参数化模型。与此不同，我们提供了一种替代的识别策略，该策略假设两个桥函数的存在，而不需要完备性条件。我们还基于极小极大学习形式为这些函数提出了新的估计量。这些估计量适用于一般的函数类，例如再生核希尔伯特空间和神经网络。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需完备性条件、仅假设桥函数存在的负控制变量识别策略，并基于极小极大学习框架构建了适用于再生核希尔伯特空间和神经网络等一般函数类的新型桥函数估计量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an identification strategy for causal inference with negative controls that assumes the existence of bridge functions instead of completeness conditions, and develops new estimators based on minimax learning formulations that accommodate general function classes such as RKHS and neural networks.
